evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is positioned as an authority that enacts a rule: saving enrolls the creator — a hierarchical allocation of the reviewer role triggered by a system-asserted mandate, not a reciprocal or proportional exchange.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle subordinate to the suite's assertion — its purpose defined entirely by carrying the rule above, enacting the same authority-ranking structure where the probe serves the mandate.
